'''Ralf Baumeister''' (born September 1, 1961 in [[Schwabach]]) is a German professor (Bioinformatics and Molecular Genetics).
 
He is currently co-director of the School of Life Sciences at [[University of Freiburg|Freiburg University's]] [[Freiburg Institute for Advanced Studies|Institute of Advanced Studies]].
He uses the model organism [[Caenorhabditis elegans]] in his studies.
